commercialSummary: Mews describes itself as "Cloud-native, Mews PMS is an innovative hospitality management system that enables automation to boost revenue and empowers remarkable guest experiences". Public pages describe an integration motion. It publishes a directory listing at least 11 partner organisations. Visible partner workflows include partner recruitment, enablement. The company appears to operate the programme itself. Public evidence does not establish partner platform or partner-team size.
